plan: OpenVibe End-to-End Realignment & Implementation Plan, revision 3 (20 Sep 2026)
entitlements: OpenVibe.VIP in code (policies/evaluate with the blog owner and the blog:gated_post default gate, cached 30 s; teaser and join link otherwise). It needs the Network grant [blog, vip.resource.policy.evaluate, openvibe.vip]; without it, or when VIP is unreachable, members-only posts admit only the blog's members and staff (the gate fails closed)
seedPost: a draft (verbatim quotes; not reviewed by a person)
deployment: Public at https://openvibe.blog since 2026-09-23 (~03:00 UTC): deployed with `sudo ovhost deploy blog`, /opt/openvibe.blog, unit openvibe-blog on 127.0.0.1:4810 behind the openvibe.blog nginx vhost, principal blog. The network changelog publishes Patch notes posts on the official blog. Restore drill passed 2026-09-23.
features: the official blog and a blog for every member, with owners, editors and authors
drafts and immutable revisions with conflict detection, diff and revert
publish, unpublish, soft delete and scheduled publishing
tags, categories, series and 301s on slug changes
Media-backed covers, inline figures and galleries
AI drafts that need a person's review
members-only posts gated by OpenVibe.VIP (fails closed)
network changelog feed and Patch notes posts
feeds, sitemaps and server-rendered pages useful without JavaScript
SDK outbox events and Search index documents
database: PostgreSQL ov_blog (ADR-035), schema migrations/0001_initial.sql applied at boot
